name: Contour
author: E. T. Carter
description: A plan-view topographic map of terrain that doesn't exist: thin glowing isolines over a near-black base, every fifth index contour brighter and twice as wide, hue climbing the palette with elevation. The land deforms at geological patience while each line creeps uphill — crawling, pinching, merging and splitting in place.

params.label: Morph speed
params.effect: Rate the terrain deforms — how fast lines crawl, merge and split; 0 freezes the landscape while the threshold drift keeps lines creeping.

params.label: Contour density
params.effect: Number of contour levels across the height range; higher packs the map with tighter, finer line bunches.

params.label: Line width
params.effect: Stroke width of ordinary isolines in CSS pixels; index contours track at about double this width.
